_about: Twenty 兽潮 levels a 主力 塔防 kit, rising (Hanli 2026-10-28: 「塔防类的可以适当加到20个关卡, 每一种」): written by tools/tide-levels.mjs from each kit's maker (games/<kit>/tide.js), every one won by its human-like hand without 结印 on at least `need` of `seeds` plays (`won`); `hui` the 回 whose beasts it plays, `boss` a 大妖 in it. rules/shouchao.mjs deals a kit's levels in order (a 大妖's night its next boss level), then its maker's own nights. tests/tide-levels.test.mjs re-proves them.

name.en: Beast tide · The pill house, from the north

lead.zh: 林子里沙沙响，一路往观里来。
lead.en: A rustle in the woods, coming all the way to the temple.

lead.zh: 师兄们守着山门，丹房这边，交给你了。
lead.en: The seniors hold the gate. The pill house is yours.

lead.zh: 兽潮扑向丹房！
lead.en: The beast tide is on the pill house!

lead.zh: 狰太快，火符落地它已跑远：先用寒符拖住它。
lead.en: The zheng is too quick for fire: slow it with frost first.

lead.zh: 右边的石墙后头有金卡，打碎它，队伍就壮了。
lead.en: A gold card waits behind the stone wall on the right — break it and the squad grows.

lead.zh: 撒豆成兵！
lead.en: Beans into soldiers!

hint.en: Boars: many, straight down

hint.zh: 犰狳站定吐口水，先打它
hint.en: Qiuyu stop and spit: shoot them first

hint.zh: 合窳皮硬，火弹穿云能破
hint.en: Heyu are armoured: fire or pierce breaks it
Pierce: through the line, and armour

hint.zh: 火弹会炸开，旁边的兽也挨打
hint.en: Fireballs burst and hit the beasts beside

lead.zh: 天黑透了，蠪侄成群往沉鼎观的山门涌——兽潮来了。
lead.en: Full dark, and the longzhi pour up the road at Chending's gate — the tide is here.

lead.zh: 左边的石墙后头有金卡，打碎它，队伍就壮了。

lead.zh: 撒豆成兵！
lead.en: Beans into soldiers!

hint.zh: 蠪侄近了会炸，远处打掉
hint.en: Longzhi burst up close: kill them far off

hint.zh: 犰狳站定吐口水，先打它
hint.en: Qiuyu stop and spit: shoot them first
Boars: many, straight down
Rapid fire: twice the shots
Pierce: through the line, and armour

lead.zh: 师兄们都守在后山，今夜的山门交给小满。兽潮压下来了。
lead.en: The senior disciples hold the back hill; tonight Chending's gate is Xiaoman's. The tide is coming down.

lead.zh: 右边的石墙后头有金卡，打碎它，队伍就壮了。

hint.en: Longzhi burst up close: kill them far off
Zheng: thick hide, focus your fire
Rapid fire: twice the shots
Frost: the beasts slow down

lead.zh: 山道上黑压压一片，狰、犰狳、合窳都冲着沉鼎观的山门来了。
lead.en: The mountain road goes black with them — zheng, qiuyu, heyu, all coming at Chending's gate.

lead.zh: 后头还跟着合窳——它冲哪一列，就躲开哪一列。
lead.en: And behind them, the Heyu — get off whatever column it charges.

lead.zh: 夜里，兽潮压到了山门下。
lead.en: Night, and the beast tide is at Chending's gate.

lead.zh: 小满开了山门，豆兵们跟我冲！
lead.en: Xiaoman throws the gate open. Soldiers, with me!

lead.zh: 打退兽潮！
lead.en: Break the tide!

lead.zh: 山门前，兽群压了上来。
lead.en: Before the gate, the beasts are pressing in.

lead.zh: 小满带着豆兵，往山道下冲——
lead.en: Xiaoman takes the bean soldiers charging down the road —

lead.zh: 撒豆成兵！
lead.en: Beans into soldiers!

lead.zh: 山门前，兽群压了上来。
lead.en: Before the gate, the beasts are pressing in.

lead.zh: 小满抓出一把黄豆，带豆兵冲出山门——
lead.en: Xiaoman grabs a fistful of beans and leads the soldiers out of the gate —

lead.zh: 守住山门！
lead.en: Hold the gate!

lead.zh: 天黑了，兽潮冲上山道来了。
lead.en: Dark has come, and the beast tide is coming up the road.
